plan: Two independent seven-pair micro batches, then one five-pair real-workload matrix. All attempts retained; no post-hoc sample filtering. Wait for our builds/tests to finish. Unrelated host activity is not stopped.

acceptance.affectedMicro: speedup > 1.02 in both batches, ratio of medians and median of paired ratios
acceptance.controlsAndReal: candidate host duration / baseline <= 1.05 for each control and workload phase; report both ratios
acceptance.correctness: all runs complete expected work; micro exact states and retired budgets; real fixed shell result, no snapshots, identical execution policy; only favicon errors allowed

limitations: Real boots use live RTC and can retire different work. End-to-end wall time is authoritative, not MIPS or deterministic equivalence. Control measurements expose host noise.
